units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 2:3">Yeb. II, 3</cite>, a. e. <he>איסור ק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01405"><he>אִיסּוּר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 55a">Kidd. 55ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>קְדוּשַּׁת הגוף</he> an object which is consecrated as such (irredeemable), opp. <he>ק׳ דמים</he> that which is consecrated for its value (redeemable).
<cite ref="Temurah 10b:27">Tem. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דמפרש ק׳ על הולד</he> because he has pronounced sanctity on the embryo (by dedicating the mother).
<cite ref="Temurah 10a:39">Ib.ᵃ</cite> <he>אין ק׳ חלה על עיברין</he> no sanctification takes effect on embryos (by the dedication of the mothers).
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 7:1">Naz. VII, 1</cite> <he>נזיר שאין קְדוּשָּׁתוֹ קדושת עולם</he> the Nazarite whose sanctification is not an everlasting one (it ceasing with the expiration of his vow).

<cite ref="Chagigah 3b:10">Ḥag. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ ראשונה קִדְּשָׁהּ לשעתה</he> as to the first consecration (of the holy land by Joshua), he consecrated it only for the time being (as long as inhabited and ruled by Israelites); <cite ref="Megillah 10b">Meg. 10ᵇ</cite>, sq.; <cite ref="Zevachim 60b:7">Zeb. 60ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—
Hor. 13ᵃ זה גדל עמנו בק׳ וזה לא וכ׳ the one (the nathin, v. נָתִין) has grown up with us in holiness (under the influences of the Jewish religion), and the other (the proselyte) has not &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 58a:1">Snh. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>לידתו בק׳</he> born in holiness (after his mother’s conversion); <cite ref="Yevamot 98a">Yeb. 98ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00284"><he>הוֹרָת</he></cite>; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: sanctification, proclaiming the holiness of the Lord, solemn public act connected with the idea of Israel’s priesthood.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 23b:15">Meg. 23ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 21b:4">Ber. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>כל דבר שבק׳ לא יהא וכ׳</he> no sacred public act should be performed with less than ten persons.—Esp. <he>קְדוּשַּׁת הַשֵּׁם</he>

senses.gloss: sanctification of the Name, fidelity to the Jewish faith, martyrdom. Ib. 20ᵃ מסרי נפשייהו אק׳ ה׳, v. מְסַר.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 74b:8">Snh. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>מצווה על ק׳ ה׳</he> bound to sanctify the Name (with his life); a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: ק׳ השם, or קדושה the third section of the Prayer of Benedictions (תְּפִלָּה), praising the holiness of the Lord; the appeal to the congregation to join in the ‘holy, holy &c.’ (v. קָדוֹשׁ).
units: R. Hash. IV, 5 סדר ברכות … וק׳ ה׳ the order of the benedictions (for the New Year’s Day) is: Aboth (v. אָב), G’buroth (v. גְּבוּרָה) and the sanctification.
Ber. 21ᵇ עד שלא יגיע … ק׳ before the reader reaches the ḳ’dushshah.

Ib. אין היחיד אומר ק׳ one praying alone should not recite the ḳ’dushshah; a. fr.—קדושת היום (ק׳ שבת, ק׳ יום טוב), also ק׳ declaration of the sanctity of the day (the Sabbath &c.) in prayer or at meals. R. Hash. l. c. ק׳ היום that section of the Prayer of Benedictions which closes with the benediction ‘who sanctifiest the day &c.’ Bets. 15ᵇ לוו עלי וקדשו ק׳ היום וכ׳ borrow on my (the Lord’s) account and celebrate the sanctity of the day, and trust me &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 33b:15">Ber. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>בין ק׳ שבת לק׳ יו״ט הבדלת</he> thou hast made a distinction between the way of sanctifying the Sabbath and that of sanctifying the Holy Day.

<cite ref="Pesachim 105a:10">Pes. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ על הכוס</he> the proclamation of the sanctity of the Day over a cup of wine (<cite ref="S00873"><he>קִידּוּשׁ</he></cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְדוּשּׁוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 1:6">Kel. I, 6</cite> <he>עשר ק׳ הן</he> there are ten degrees of territorial sanctity.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:12">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵃ</cite> top; Tanḥ. K’dosh. 4 (ref. to <cite ref="Joshua 24:19">Josh. XXIV, 19</cite>) <he>שהוא קדוש בכל מיני ק׳ וכ׳</he> he is holy in all kinds of holy acts, for all his doings are in holiness, his speech is in holiness &c.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24">Lev. R. s. 24</cite> <he>שלש ק׳</he> three times ‘holy’, v. <cite ref="K01386"><he>כָּתַר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 272">Yalk. Is. 272</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 33a:27">Ber. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>אנשי … ק׳ והבדלות</he> the men of the Great Assembly instituted for Israel blessings (on enjoyments of food &c.), daily prayers, sanctification of sacred days (over wine), and the blessing at the exit of sacred days (v. <cite ref="E00028"><he>הַבְדָּלָה</he></cite>); a. fr.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:8:10">Y. Ned. VI, end, 40ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:33">Y. Snh. I, 19ᵃ</cite> top (in irony) <he>לקדושת חנניה</he> to his holiness Hanania (who had usurped the functions of the Palestine authorities).
